content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant challenges. The inability to accept payments hampers the growth of your online store. However, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-13|COREMERCH guide to building]] a robust order database using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-11|How to]]-order-database-digital-stores-what-nobody-tells|supabase]] allows you to create a seamless digital store without relying on these platforms. This guide outlines the steps to deploy a powerful infrastructure that supports crypto payments and data ownership, ensuring you maintain complete control over your digital commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often block users in specific regions, limiting access to essential tools for digital commerce. This is where COREMERCH's infrastructure shines. By leveraging free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, alongside NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you eliminate the dependency on restricted platforms. The architecture provides complete ownership and control over your digital store, empowering you to operate freely and efficiently. With Stack 01 or Stack 02, you are equipped to handle payments seamlessly and maintain your sovereignty over data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store using Supabase as the order database, ensure you have the necessary tools in hand. For Stack 01, you need a GitHub account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script integration, and a NOWPayments account to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Alternatively, Stack 02 requires a Cloudflare account for hosting, access to Cloudflare Workers, and a Supabase project setup for your order database. Familiarize yourself with each component, as understanding their roles will streamline the deployment process and help you troubleshoot any issues down the line.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your accounts set up, it’s time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. For Stack 01, utilize Google Apps Script to automate tasks within your GitHub Pages hosted store, integrating NOWPayments for crypto acceptance. Ensure your payment processing is connected to your order database in Supabase, allowing for real-time order tracking. For Stack 02, use Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic, seamlessly connecting to Supabase for order management and NOWPayments for payment verification. This configuration ensures that once a payment is processed, the delivery of digital products is automatic and instant.
Own your digital store infrastructure, no dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After configuration, you're ready to go live. Test your setup on the mainnet to ensure all components work together harmoniously, from payment processing to product delivery. For Stack 01, this means running through the payment flow to confirm that your GitHub Pages site correctly captures orders and delivers products without issues. With Stack 02, validate your Cloudflare Workers script to ensure it processes requests accurately. Once confirmed, you can promote your store confidently, knowing your digital commerce infrastructure is robust and reliable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational, focus on scaling your infrastructure. Start by analyzing order volume and customer data in Supabase to identify growth opportunities. For Stack 02, you can easily expand your offerings by adding more products to your Supabase database and updating your Cloudflare Workers accordingly. Ensure your payment processing with NOWPayments can handle increased transactions without delays. Additionally, actively engage with your audience to gather feedback, refine your product offerings, and enhance user experience, ensuring your digital store remains competitive and responsive to market demands.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, set up your order database using Supabase and host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions without any platform dependency. This infrastructure allows for full ownership and control over your digital products.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with ease using NOWPayments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to scale further, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers enhanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and 30-day support, all while ensuring your store operates on a solid foundation. For more details on available products, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?
To build a free digital store that accepts crypto payments, utilize GitHub Pages for hosting, Supabase for your order database, and integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 employs GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours and includes more advanced features.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide excellent free hosting solutions tailored for digital commerce without platform restrictions.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital assets. This flexibility enables you to cater to a diverse customer base.
How do I ensure data ownership in my digital store?
By using Supabase for your order database and hosting on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you maintain full ownership of your data without relying on third-party platforms.
